title: GreenBoost serving preset
description: NemoClaw audit, Phase 7. GreenBoost-native (re-implemented from scratch — no code copied) version of the IDEAS in NemoClaw's preset.schema.json + resolver.ts: a preset names a recipe (serving/recipes/*.yaml) plus a requirements.all[] list of typed, scoped facts that must ALL hold before this preset is eligible. serving/resolver.py evaluates presets against a facts snapshot (from gb_readiness.build_report() plus per-node cluster facts) and picks the highest-priority ELIGIBLE preset — raising ambiguous-selection on a priority tie rather than silently picking one.

priority.description: Higher wins. Two ELIGIBLE presets sharing the top priority is an ambiguous-selection error, not a silent pick — see resolver.py.

recipeRef.description: A serving/recipes/*.yaml filename this preset resolves to when selected.

scope.description: controller: checked once against the host's own facts. everyNode: must hold for every node in the cluster fact snapshot (including the host). anyNode: must hold for at least one node.

kind.description: qualification/observation/capability default to a truthy check on the named id's value when no operator/value is given; comparison/fact require both.

id.description: dotted fact id, e.g. host.gpu.vram_total_bytes, kmod.greenboost.loaded

value.description: required when operator is given; the comparison target
